text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Now that it has come to this, we will likely need to
re-evaluate everything from the ground up."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: What are your thoughts on this, Trainer?
choice_data_list: There's no choice but to train rigorously.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A course...?
Do you mean a course correction?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: So we identify the reason why it didn't yield results, return to that point, and search for a different path.
choice_data_list: I'll definitely find the path that leads to victory.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I don't mind, even if it requires a major change of course.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Let us seek out a path bathed in light.
And put an end to defeat, once and for all."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If necessary, I would be more than willing.
What are the specific plans?
choice_data_list: I'll analyze today's race and put a strategy together.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you.
...You're keeping a cool head. That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Then let us reconsider everything from scratch.
We will begin our discussion from there.
